name: FloodNet: High-Resolution UAV Aerial Imagery for Post-Flood Scene Understanding
description: FloodNet is a high-resolution unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) dataset created for post-disaster flood damage assessment. Gathered by researchers at UMBC following Hurricane Harvey, it contains 2,343 ultra-high-resolution aerial images (4000x3000) with detailed semantic segmentation masks across 10 categories including flooded roads and damaged structures, along with 11,000 visual question answering pairs.
